name: x-zero-never-expires
needle: a zero interval disables probe demand even at answer acceptance

name: dafresh-half-range
needle: freshness intervals at or above the clock half range are refused

name: dafresh-unanswered-clock
needle: freshness requires an answered probe even at clock zero

name: dafresh-expiry-equality
needle: a probe older than the freshness window cannot declare

name: dafresh-inclusive-edge
needle: the exact fifteen second boundary closes the declaration

name: dafresh-no-renewal
needle: another answer renews the complete freshness window

name: dafresh-listener-needs-probe
needle: a registered Listener declares without any answered probe

name: dafresh-ignore-address
needle: invalid destination blocks both fresh and registered demand

name: dafresh-absolute-clock
needle: unsigned elapsed time keeps a probe fresh across clock wrap

name: dafresh-fixed-window
needle: the core uses the configured interval without a mirrored constant

name: dafresh-refused-answer
needle: a queued response does not yet count as an answer

name: dafresh-only-success
needle: an answered allocation failure retains demand for later validity

name: dafresh-state-reply-demand
needle: other talker commands cannot supply probe freshness

name: dafresh-wrong-source
needle: a probe on the second source leaves the first source closed

name: dafresh-wrong-interface
needle: Listener interface must match the configured source interface

name: dafresh-reset-retains-demand
needle: initialization clears previous demand and probe timestamps

name: dafresh-generated-window
needle: generated freshness configuration survives both target round trips

name: g-expiry-skipped-with-listener
needle: Listener withdrawal after a serviced full wrap cannot revive an expired probe

name: g-expiry-skipped-invalid-da
needle: destination recovery after a serviced full wrap cannot revive an expired probe
